title: UAAP: La Salle men overturn 2-goal deficit to frustrate Adamson
summary: De La Salle University frustrated league-leading Adamson University in a 2-2 draw in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament on Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
